instruction.text: Use your division skills to find the answer to the problem.

atoms.a: Emily is going on holiday for 10 days, and wants to work out how much food she has to feed her cat. She has 15 pouches of cat food left. How many pouches per day does she have?
Rishi is going on holiday for 10 days and has £85 saved up. How much money does he have to spend per day?
There are 10 people running a race and 20 litres of water at the checkpoints. How much water is there for each runner?

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to complete and solve the equation needed to work out the answer to the problem.

atoms.a: There are 10 people signed up for Sunday’s pottery workshop and 4 kg of clay. How much clay will each participant receive?
Isaac wants to cycle 30 miles in 10 days. How many miles does he need to cycle each day to reach his goal?
Clara’s garden has 10 patches of soil, and she has 20 seeds in total. How many seeds can she plant in each patch?
